actionability.justification: The rule gives a concrete pre-send check (verify any specifically named field/value/deliverable actually appears in the output) rather than a vague admonition to 'be careful.'

generality_without_vagueness.justification: It generalizes from the one dropped payload field to any named requirement (field, value, single deliverable) without collapsing into an empty platitude like 'double-check your work.'

leakage.justification: remedy_content stays generic ('a field, a value, a single deliverable') and never names the specific payload/field from the evidence.

routing_fitness.justification: claude-md is a defensible cheap choice for a non-mechanical semantic check, but overlap_action names 'proposal #3' as the target to revise while the dedup section itself identifies the actual overlap as R5 (and marks R3 as unrelated/clear) — an internal inconsistency that risks merging this into the wrong existing remedy.

trigger_quality.justification: As a claude-md standing rule it has no skill-style 'Use when...' gate; its only trigger is 'before sending a response,' which is acceptable for a standing discipline but is broad rather than tightly scoped to the omission pattern.
